title: Sandbox to Production Bridge Canvas
body:
Context and goal:
- Customer: AcmeData (data insights platform)
- Use case: Assist agents that summarize long customer reports and rerank table rows.
- Primary objective: deliver a reproducible path from sandbox trial to a production inference deployment that meets latency and cost SLOs within a 30-day engagement window.

Working success criteria (30-day):
- Functional: API integration + nightly batch ingestion into sandbox verified and demoable to customer.
- Performance: p50 generation latency < 350 ms for 1k token prompts (target), p95 < 900 ms under baseline load (10 rps).
- Cost envelope: host cost < $0.30 per 1k prompt tokens at the observed load (measured in Redwood console).
- Quality: no more than 5% regression on 10 curated prompts vs baseline model outputs (manual eval).
- Handoff: runbook + terraform snippets committed to GH + 2 knowledge-transfer sessions.

High-level phases and day-level trajectory (30 days):
- D0–D2: Discovery + alignment workshop (workshop notes + acceptance checklist). Deliverable: runbook stub and prioritized integration tasks.
- D3–D8: Sandbox provisioning and data plumbing. Tasks: create sandbox project, ingest sample reports, configure API keys, map schemas. Owner: Aisha.
- D9–D15: Integration build (app side). Tasks: implement client calls, error handling, streaming, and fallback hooks. Owner: Marcus.
- D16–D20: Performance tuning & quantization experiment. Tasks: test 8-bit quantized model variant, tune batching, enable prefix cache. Owner: Elena.
- D21–D26: Reliability and scale tests. Tasks: run 10–50 rps load tests, simulate region failover, validate autoscaling policy. Owner: Samir.
- D27–D29: Acceptance testing + customer demo rehearsal. Tasks: run PROMPT evals, collect metrics, update playbook. Owner: Marcus+Aisha.
- D30: Final demo + handoff. Deliverable: handoff PR, runbook, and 2-hour KT session.

Weekly checkpoints (recommended):
- Mon standup: visible blockers, infra tickets, and test cadence.
- Wed sync: demo incremental progress (sandbox snapshots).
- Fri show-and-tell: metrics snapshot, open issues, next-week plan.

Detailed task tracker (examples, not exhaustive):
- Sandbox: provision project, VPC peering (customer request?), KMS access scope, test keys — due D5, owner Aisha.
- Data: sample report ingestion script (CSV/Parquet), data redaction demo — due D7, owner Elena.
- API integration: client lib + retry/backoff, sample webhook — due D14, owner Marcus.
- Streaming: implement server-side chunking and client reassembly test harness — due D12, owner Marcus.
- Batching policy: set dynamic batch window 15–25 ms for low latency paths — due D18, owner Elena.
- Quantization experiment: run 4 runs (int8, int8+kv, fp16 baseline, q4) and capture latency/cost/quality — due D20, owner Elena.
- Load test: scripted 1k-token prompt scenarios at 10/25/50 rps, capture p50/p95/p99 — due D24, owner Samir.

Open questions / tradeoffs (notes to self):
- Customer might require private deployment for regulated datasets; contingency: cost/time to spin up Private image? 
- Is prefix caching acceptable for PII redaction constraints? Need security review.
- Decide whether to favor lower latency (dedicated nodes) vs lower cost (hosted + quant) for pilot.

Risk register (short):
- Infra delay: VPC/KMS provisioning can add 3–7 days. Mitigation: request org-admin pre-approval during discovery.
- Model quality regression after quant: Mitigation: maintain fallback to fp16 and guardrail eval set.
- Unexpected throughput constraints due to long sequences: Mitigation: token trimming policy + chunking.

Acceptance checklist (what to demo to customer):
- End-to-end demo: ingest -> index -> query -> summarize + rerank, with logs shown in Redwood Console.
- Metrics: show p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens, per-route breakdown.
- Failover: demonstrate automatic fallback to baseline model during simulated quota exhaustion.
- Security: show KMS integration, audit log for sample request.

Handoff artifacts to produce by D30:
- runbook.md (step-by-step deploy + A/B rollback)
- terraform/ (network + infra snippets) — push GH-PR-1184
- obs-dashboards (console links + PDF snapshot)
- short KT slide deck (30–45 min)

Meeting cadence and attendees (recommended):
- Weekly eng-customer sync (Marcus, Aisha, Elena, Samir, customer eng lead) — 30min
- Mid-eng demo (internal) — 45min
- Final demo + accept (customer-facing) — 60min

Notes and working reminders (informal):
- Bookmark: latency traces in Console -> route: /generate -> filter by model.
- Keep eval prompts in a single file under /evals/acmedata/seed_prompts.txt — update as we iterate.
- If customer asks for on-prem wording: "Private deployment evaluation" not "on-prem" in initial comms.

Next immediate actions (today):
- Send alignment email with workshop agenda + ask for sandbox SKUs from customer (Marcus).
- Create sandbox project and upload 3 sample reports to S3 bucket (Aisha).
- Open GH-PR-1184 for terraform skeleton (Samir).

Quick links (dev):
- Confluence spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SE/AcmeData+Integration+Spec
- Jira epic: PROJ-342
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1184

End of canvas — this is a working document: update checklist after every milestone. Keep notes messy here; transfer polished artifacts to Confluence at handoff.
